title: Inertial confinement of a magnetically driven implosion (ICF confinement time)
description: Ellison benchmark 4. A magnetically driven implosion in which the inertial confinement time of the stagnated fuel column is directly measured. The simulation must reproduce the stagnation scalars (minimum fuel radius, peak fuel density) and the confinement time. All three are STATED TEXT SCALARS in Knapp 2017 (not figure-digitized): tau_conf = 14 ns (vs 16 ns from 1D), min radius 0.45 mm, peak density ~10 g/cc. The inner-radius-vs-time trajectory point cloud (figure-only) is digitized separately under digitization_review/.
